records.title: Tea Research Associations
details:
I have asked two large tea buyers to get involved in the activities of the tea research institution so that in a Public Private Partnership mode we can see significant progress and development in research activates.
Recently, they have told me that they are going to come back to me and we shall work together in a spirit of cooperation to the best extent possible to rejuvenate the activates of the Tea Research Associations.

details:
